name: Dylan's Pokémon of the Day
subtitle: A Pokémon a day, and the whole Pokédex
description: A new Pokémon every day, the same one as on the wall: its official art, a short life lesson it teaches with one small thing to try today, what the Pokédex says about it in three games, its base stats, what it's weak to and resists, and its evolution family.
Below it, the whole Pokédex: all 1,025 Pokémon from Kanto to Paldea as the games' pixel sprites. Find one by name or number, or tap any of them to see its entry.
features: A lesson from it, and something to try today
Its Pokédex entries, stats and matchups
Its evolution family, to tap through
The whole Pokédex: 1,025 Pokémon, nine regions
